scope:
sensor-r3 PCB checks: the C1 pan-sensor channels on the zapote/controller board.

HANDOFF section B, items 1-9. Every number in pcb/*.md comes from this script.
Run:  python3 checks.py   -> checks.json  (exit 1 if any gate fails)

Circuit under test
- "captured": zapote/controller as captured on branch controller-layout
  (300b8a934, read-only): RTDSensing (MAX31865, 430 R Yageo RT 0.1 % 25 ppm,
  1 nF C0G across RTDIN, 1 M open-lead pull-ups at the pins, REF2025 window,
  TLV3201 runaway at BIAS/3 on the 100 k window branch), rim NTC on J12
  (104GT-2, 1.00 k pull-up, 10 k/100 nF, TLV9061, GPIO9 ADC1).
- "proposed": the same plus CHANGE-REQUEST.md: 2-stage RC on the sense lines
  (1.00 k / 100 nF C0G / 1.00 k / 100 nF C0G + 2 x 1 nF CM), pull-ups and
  window taps moved to the connector side, 10 nF on the window node,
  ESD5Z3.3 on the four RTD lines, Rref 430 R 0.05 % 5 ppm, rim trip.

Method: a small complex modified-nodal-analysis solver (numpy) for the AC
pickup cases and the DC fault/loading cases; datasheet worst-case corners.
Datasheet values are in SRC with their source; "assumption" marks every value
that is an engineering allowance rather than a datasheet limit.

sources.MAX31865: Maxim MAX31865 19-6478 Rev 3 (datasheets/max31865.pdf): VBIAS 1.95-2.06 V, bias load reg 30 mV/mA, IOUT max 5.75 mA, 15 bit, offset -3..+3 LSB (max), full-scale +/-1 LSB (typ), INL +/-1 LSB (typ), input leakage 14 nA (typ, -40..100 C), conversion 16.7 ms typ / 17.6 ms max continuous 60 Hz notch, analog pins 0..VBIAS, protection opens >VDD+0.1 V or <GND-0.4 V (D2), RREF 350 R..10 k, cable <=50 R/lead, auto fault cycle valid only if input RC tau <=100 us, sinc3 filter
sources.Pt100: IEC 60751 Callendar-Van Dusen A 3.9083e-3, B -5.775e-7 (T>=0), C -4.183e-12 (T<0)
sources.Rref_captured: Yageo RT0805BRD07430RL 0.1 % 25 ppm/K (controller C35 R39 swap)
sources.Rref_proposed: Susumu RG2012V-431-W-T1 0.05 %, 5 ppm/K (RG2012V series, V = +/-5 ppm; RTD unit's original part, swapped out in C35 for stock only)
sources.board_temp: controller_calcs.py TEMP_SPAN_K 60 (25 -> 85 C board); 0 C lower bound (assumption)
sources.TLV3201: TI SBOS561C: VIO +/-5 mV max (as used in controller_calcs.runaway)
sources.ESD5Z3.3: onsemi ESD5Z3.3T1G: VRWM 3.3 V, IR 50 nA max at VRWM, 25 C (controller_parts.ato basis)
sources.104GT-2: Semitec GT-2 series datasheet 2023-08-01 R-T table (copied in controller_calcs.py): 100 k +/-3 %, B25/85 4267 K +/-2 %, -50..+300 C, 0.6 mW/K still air
sources.ESP32-S3 ADC: 12 bit; calibrated error bounds used: ATTEN0 +/-5 mV, ATTEN2 +/-10 mV, ATTEN3 +/-50 mV (assumption to confirm against the ESP32-S3 datasheet ADC table at capture)
sources.v3v3: TPS62933 3.3 V rail 3.242-3.367 V, measured by MCP3202 CH1 against LM4040A25 0.1 % (controller DECISIONS C20)
sources.tank_cm: output/temper-coil-driver-r1/tank_cm.json: winding-mean CM voltage (one-sided bank) and winding-to-pan 70-81 pF (enclosure study 16)
sources.coil: native-21 tank 242 V rms / 640 V peak recurring, 33-60 kHz (R40 DECISIONS item 2, power stage)
sources.B_eye: R43 G7 spring screen B 5-20 mT in the coil eye; electronics field 0.19-0.57 mT (R37, R41)
sources.manganin: Isabellenhuette MANGANIN: rho 0.43 uOhm m, k 22 W/mK, thermo-EMF vs Cu <1 uV/K (0-100 C); 2 uV/K used to 150 C (assumption)
sources.constantan: Type T (Cu-constantan) Seebeck ~41 uV/K at 25 C, ~52 uV/K at 150 C (NIST ITS-90 tables)

detail.limits: LSB <=0.05 K; RTD/Rref <=0.95 (headroom); IOUT <=5.75 mA; cable <=50 R/lead

detail.method: gain-only calibration with a calibrated 50 ppm reference resistor at R(200 C) on J3, board 25 C; board 0-85 C (|dT| 60 K); MAX31865 offset bounded +/-3 LSB independently at cal and use (strict, no drift spec exists); FS and INL are datasheet typ only; firmware removes the nominal pull-up loading (Rref/Rb); VBIAS cancels (ratiometric, REF2025 only sets window thresholds)
detail.requirement: +/-0.3 K. Gate: the board-controlled terms (Rref, calibration, loading, leakage, thermo-EMF) stacked linearly <=0.30 K AND the RSS of all terms incl. the MAX31865 <=0.30 K. The strict linear stack incl. the MAX31865 is reported, not gated: its +/-3 LSB offset bound alone is 0.23 K at 250 C with no drift spec (DECISIONS D3)
detail.ageing_not_in_gate: Rref load-life drift (Susumu RG datasheet value to be recorded at order); 0.01 % drift = 0.05 K at 250 C

detail.config: CONFIG 0xC0: D7 VBIAS on, D6 auto, D4 0 (4-wire), D3:2 00, D0 0 (60 Hz notch); write 0xC2 once to clear faults
detail.DRDY: captured board routes RTD_DRDY to TCA9555 P07 (DECISIONS C23), not a GPIO. Requirement: firmware reads the RTD registers every 20 ms (>= one conversion, 50 Hz), checking that the code changed within 3 reads (stale-data detection), or polls P07; rtd_service.c's GPIO ISR must be ported to that. >=16 Hz holds either way.
detail.fault_cycle: with input tau >100 us the automatic fault cycle is invalid (datasheet); use the manual cycle at power-up and only when the coil is off (it opens FORCE-, stops conversions and steps the bias current).

detail.P1: bias is the MAX31865's continuous measuring current (VBIAS on in auto mode); no modulation, no pulse, firmware must not use the offset as a contact signal (Impulse dep. 3 / spec)

detail.cm_1V_test: 1 V pk CM at J3 through 600 R per line (150 R total, IEC 61000-4-6 CDN convention), tolerance corners; gated at 40 kHz as the handoff states, swept for information
detail.criterion: residual amplitude at RTDIN+/- below 1 LSB, no credit for the sinc3 filter (covers aliasing against the unknown modulator clock and rectification)

detail.note: element-parallel leakage (insulation breakdown in the hot zone) reads low and is electrically invisible above ~50 R; it is covered thermally (D1, Pt100-vs-rim check) and by the rim hardware trip; the cartridge must hold >=1041 k (spec 10 M) between leads at 300 C

detail.choice: keep the captured GPIO9 / ADC1_CH8 channel (C27 freed it, so ADC1 is not full); reject ADS1115 (the sensor's own B tolerance dominates accuracy; an I2C ADC would not move it)
detail.open: open bead reads full scale = 'below ~93 C': detect as fault when the Pt100 estimate has been >=150 C for 600 s and the rim still reads saturated
detail.short: node < 0.25 V (beyond the 290 C table end) -> rim fault; short to GND reads 0 V
detail.cross_check_threshold: Pt100-below-rim threshold must exceed the rim error: use 25 K, not 15 K (rim worst linear 10.2 K at 250 C)

detail.parts: ESD5Z3.3T1G on J3.1-4 and J12.1 (already used on J12, J9, J10); series R: 2 x 1.00 k on each sense line (filter); none on FORCE+/- (series R in the force loop moves the runaway trip, see item 8)
detail.max_pin_rating: MAX31865 FORCE/RTDIN abs max +/-50 V, protected to +/-45 V; TVS clamps first
detail.pickup_with_tvs: item 4 includes 50 pF per line at J3; TVS on the low-impedance cable side does not change the RC corners

detail.working_voltage: 242.0 V rms, 640.0 V peak recurring, 33-60 kHz (tank class)
detail.pollution_degree: PD3 in the coil eye (spill path past the wiper); CTI >=175 (group IIIa)

requirement.solid: >=2 mm solid (IEC 60335-1 29.3) or three thin layers each passing the reinforced test; cable insulation alone is not credited

detail.applies_to: winding, coil leads, ferrite bars (PC95 is semi-conductive: treat as tank potential), resonant bank, versus every cartridge/cable conductor and any floating metal (spring, wave spring) that can bridge to one
detail.basis: IEC 60664-1 values as recorded in R40 DECISIONS item 2 (from memory, both sessions); IEC 60664-4 applies above 30 kHz - x1.25 clearance allowance; certifier confirms

detail.rtd_runaway_note: C1 leads 0.9-1.1 x 1.80 R/conductor and the unspecified FORCE- switch 0-20 R (the captured C6 band assumed 0-1 R leads, no switch). Captured: divider bottom at GND, so every ohm in the FORCE- return moves the trip. Proposed: divider bottom at the connector-side S- (ratiometric to V(BIAS)-V(S-)), which removes the FORCE- path. Latched by the interlock; TLV3201 internal hysteresis only. Gate: above 250 C max setpoint + 5 K B2 overshoot + 15 K; below the bond's 325 C intermittent limit
detail.rim_trip_note: ORed into RUNAWAY_FAULT (interlock has no free input). Rim NTC is outside the cap, so the Pt100 stays the only under-cap sensor feeding hardware (US10278238B2 rule). Enable only after bench T3 logs the max rim temperature under a 250 C hold <= band low - 10 K (study 08: glass underside 12-46 K below the pan at 200 C)

rows.basis: captured ESD5Z3.3 has VRWM 3.3 V < v3v3 max 3.367 V; CR swaps to ESD5Z5.0T1G
Alpha Wire 55493 -80..+200 C, 300 V, UL AWM 20229; route <=105 C
M22759/12 PTFE Ni-Cu 260 C 600 V; local max <=200 C (CAD G8)
Molex Micro-Fit 3.0 -40..+105 C; place where <=85 C
glass-fibre sleeve or PI bore; >=10 M between leads at 300 C

detail.decision: low-k Pt leads in MANGANIN (same k as constantan, CAD G4 unchanged; thermo-EMF vs Cu about 25x lower), sense leads twisted S+/S-, force leads F+/F-

firmware_constants.rim_atten: ATTEN0 if node <0.80 V, ATTEN2 if <1.55 V, else ATTEN3; divide by v3v3/3.300 from MCP3202 CH1
